decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Fire Statement. Received 18/03/2025; Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment and HMO Management Plan. Received 29/01/2026; S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, S-05, S-06, S-07, S-08, S-09, S-10 and S-11. Received on 11/03/2026].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Prior to first use of the development hereby approved, secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than six bicycles) for the occupants of the development shall be provided. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter always retained for use without obstruction.

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 4 - Prior to first use of the development hereby approved, the developer shall provide the required set of containers for the storage and collection of recyclable materials for the purposes of the Council's relevant recycling service, to the specification then in use by the local authority's recycling collection service and shall notify the Council's refuse and recycling services when the development is first occupied.

Bins shall be always stored within the storage area outside of the collection service times and shall not be left on the public highway. The recycling facilities shall thereafter be always retained for such use without obstruction.

The collection point for the property's domestic waste shall be agreed by the Council's Waste and Recycling team. All domestic waste in association with the approved development shall be placed within the designated waste receptacle for dwellings above shops, for collection. Purple refuse sacks shall not be left on the public highway.

Reason: In order to protect the quality of the local environment and neighbours' living conditions and to ensure appropriate means of refuse storage are provided.

Condition : 5 - Prior to first use of the development hereby approved, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) hereby permitted, so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.

Reason: In order to protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 6 - House in multiple occupation occupancy

The house in multiple occupation hereby approved shall not be occupied by more than three persons at any one time.

Reason: In order to secure acceptable living conditions and to confine the occupancy level of the House in multiple occupation.
description: Conversion of 2 bedroom flat into 3bed HMO - 3 occupants
